intro: Mallacoota does much of its talking on Facebook. These are the groups worth being in, and what each is for.

links.title: Mallacoota Now
links.description: Nature, wildlife, weather, fires, tides and daily life. Open to everyone - locals, visitors, part-timers and people who simply love the place. Posts go straight up: it is a public group, not a moderated one.

links.title: Mallacoota Buy, Swap and Sell
links.description: Where the town's classifieds actually happen. Boats, firewood, furniture, and work wanted or offered.

links.title: Mallacoota Weather
links.description: Local observation rather than forecast - what the wind and the bar are actually doing, from people looking at them.

links.title: Love Mallacoota
links.description: The group for this website. Suggestions, corrections, and what you would like the weekly edition to carry.

links.title: Gippsland, Victoria
links.description: Wider than the town - the region either side of us, for when the news is bigger than Mallacoota.

links.title: Mallacoota Birds
links.description: What is about and where - sightings, photographs and the arguments about which raptor that was.
links.meta: For the twitchers, and everyone who has wondered

invite.heading: Know one we have missed?
invite.body: Clubs, sporting groups, the school, church notices, markets, arts, fishing, fire and emergency pages - if there is a page the town actually uses and it is not here, tell us.
invite.rule: Public pages and groups only. We do not list private, closed or invitation-only groups: a link is only worth printing if anyone reading it can follow it. A public group that asks a joining question is still public.
invite.label: Suggest a page or group
